title: The original Porkchop
summary: Victoria "Porkchop" Parker was the first contestant eliminated on RuPaul's Drag Race (US-S01-E01). Fans later coined "Porkchop" as the nickname for any season's first-out queen.

title: BeBe Zahara Benet wins Season 1
summary: In the Grand Finale (US-S01-E08), BeBe Zahara Benet and Nina Flowers lip-synced to RuPaul's "Cover Girl (Put the Bass in Your Walk)". BeBe was crowned America's Next Drag Superstar; Nina finished as runner-up. The Season 1 cash prize was $20,000.

title: No Snatch Game on Season 1
summary: RuPaul's Drag Race Season 1 (and All Stars 1) did not feature a Snatch Game episode. The celebrity-impersonation challenge format arrived in later seasons and became a franchise staple.

title: Ongina's HIV disclosure
summary: During Season 1, Ongina publicly discussed living with HIV — a landmark moment for the show. The reunion (US-S01-E09) revisited her story alongside other season moments; she was eliminated after the US-S01-E05 lip sync.

title: Nina Flowers: runner-up and Miss Congeniality
summary: Nina Flowers won the first maxi challenge of the franchise, reached the final lip sync against BeBe Zahara Benet, and was voted Miss Congeniality by viewers — announced at the Season 1 reunion (US-S01-E09).
